name: smwmusic-solstice-title-theme
title: Solstice - Title Theme
description:
The title screen of one of Tim Follin's best work of NES, transcribed for the SNES. Good for a Prog Rock-like opening.

03/07 Update: The port is now finally optimized. It become much more readable and managed to decrease the insert size by half of what it was before.
